method: From the Kalshi legs priced 30–85¢ with edge ≥ −2.5¢ and no flags (one per game), a leg was kept only when at least two of these agreed and none disagreed: Polymarket's top sports traders positioned on its side (not heavily against), a published expert pick or model on its side read today, and concrete matchup/injury reasoning. Dropped as conflicts: Syracuse (≈$19k of top-trader money, but Dimers' model makes Clemson a 59% favourite), Broncos–Panthers (SI's Dewey on Denver, Covers' Vasile on Carolina), Nuggets–Pacers under (≈$13k of top-trader money on the other side), 49ers ML (Covers split: Vasile 49ers −9.5, Parker Raiders +9.5), Oregon–Ohio State over (the source page gives two different numbers). Coin flips lead; short favourites close the ladder; the N-leg bet is the first N legs not yet started.
honest: Every leg costs a little more than its fair chance (Kalshi's fee), so the expected return is slightly negative and gets worse with each leg you add. These are the best-supported legs today, not sure things.

ladder.label: Washington Commanders +5.5
ladder.why: Biggest one-sided top-trader position among legs with expert support (≈$13.5k for vs $0 against). Covers' Chris Vasile takes Washington +5.5, citing Stafford's arm, no Davante Adams and Rams defensive absences after Washington held Philadelphia to 10; the free SportsLine model has Washington covering ~60%.

ladder.game: Green Bay Packers @ New England Patriots
ladder.label: Green Bay Packers +3.5
ladder.why: Both teams are 5-3 and allow almost identical points (20.5 vs 20.3); Green Bay has extra rest after a Thursday game and New England has injuries at receiver. Covers takes Packers +3.5 and SI's Iain MacMillan Packers +2.5; top traders ≈$10.5k for vs $3k against.

ladder.label: Florida Panthers
ladder.why: TheSpread's Alex Becker takes Florida (+105): the Panthers' 23.9% power play meets a 76.1% Washington penalty kill, and Florida is 5-3-2 on the road. Top traders ≈$13.7k on Florida, nobody against. Near coin flip.

ladder.game: Tulsa Golden Hurricane @ Tulane Green Wave
ladder.label: Tulane Green Wave +3.5
ladder.why: Dimers' model calls Tulane +2.5 its top college edge today (54.3% to cover) and gives Tulane 47.7% to win outright; this is the safer +3.5. Top traders ≈$5.3k for vs $0.8k against.

ladder.label: Utah Utes −3.5
ladder.why: Covers' Rob Paul (Utah −4.5) notes Utah's top-20 defense and 7-1 ATS record with BYU's LJ Martin limited; Pickswise (Utah −4) says several BYU players are doubtful. Small but one-way top-trader money (≈$1k vs $0.1k).

ladder.label: New Orleans Saints −2.5
ladder.why: Saints come off a bye with extra rest; they average 23.1 points to Cleveland's 17.4. Covers and SI both take New Orleans −2.5, and top traders are only on this side (≈$0.6k vs $0).

ladder.label: Edmonton Oilers −1.5
ladder.why: SportsBettingDime projects Edmonton 5-2 and takes the −1.5 puck line: strong Oilers home offense vs a Vancouver team 1-8 on the road. Top traders ≈$1k for, $0 against.

ladder.label: Under 51.5
ladder.why: CBS's model hits the under (49.5) in 62% of simulations, with Tennessee's defense (2nd in sack rate per Covers) keeping it in the 40s; this leg uses the safer 51.5. Top traders ≈$1.2k on the under, nobody on the over.

ladder.label: Minnesota Wild +1.5
ladder.why: Dimers' best bet in this game is the Wild moneyline (model 47.9% vs 42.5% implied) and its model gives Minnesota +1.5 a 69.1% cover chance. Largest unopposed top-trader position in tonight's NHL (≈$34.6k vs $0).

ladder.label: Houston Cougars
ladder.why: Short home favourite. Covers' Colby Marchio takes Houston −10.5 (Cincinnati 133rd in yards allowed); top traders ≈$40.6k on Houston vs $0.3k against.
